Grand Renaissance church built for the Jesuits 1583-1599 by Duke Wilhelm V, as a bastion of the Counter-Reformation against those awful Lutherans. The Duke nearly busted the state coffers in buying up the land and funding a construction…
Museum of Urban and Contemporary Art
Street and urban art is ephemeral but the idea of MUCA, opened in 2016, is to bring it into the artistic mainstream. There's a permanent collection and rotating exhibitions.

This Late Baroque confection was built from 1733 to 1746 as a private chapel by Egid Quirin Asam - he could see the altar from his house next door. His brother, Cosmas Damian Asam, did the frescoes. The church is dedicated to St John…
Shows ballet and opera performances almost every night.

Small nightclub 100 m south of Sendlinger Tor. This venue with red plush and mirrored walls once was a hotspot of Munich's gay scene - a frequent customer was Freddie Mercury who lived nearby. Today it is an afterhours house and techno…
An easy-going café with a pleasant outdoor area in fine weather.

This Japanese restaurant continues to delight.
Trad Bavarian restaurant with a theatre and cinema in the backyard: this was film director Fassbinder's favorite restaurant.
Comfy café-bar with 70s decor in homage to Munich's 1972 Olympics.

Japanese restaurant with a modern atmosphere and freshly prepared sushi and sashimi. They also have a large assortment of cocktails and Japanese whiskeys. Pricey, and some reviewers aren't convinced it's worth the extra.
Guests sit in comfy couches or at the long bar in this cozy place. They have over 100 varieties of gin. The club remains closed in 2022.

Perched on the tip of Museum Island, this is a bar with various live events. It compares itself to the urban beach of Paris Plage, it's more like a terrace overlooking the sandbanks as the Isar divides.
Live music club in city centre, mostly R&B.
Tiny art bar turning into an electro club at night.
Techno and house club with a wooden dance floor at Sendlinger Tor.
You're not drunk (yet), the dance floor really does careen at that angle. Clutch your drink firmly while balancing on worn out couches or wooden chairs in this long narrow music venue.
